看完一集后，自动匹配 Bangumi 条目并把对应集标记为看过。: After an episode is completed, automatically match its Bangumi entry and mark the corresponding episode as watched.
自动验证已保存的密钥；所有媒体服务器账号的播放都参与同步。: Automatically check the saved token. Playback from all media server accounts is included.
进入设置和完成登录后自动验证。: Automatically checked when opening settings and after signing in.
密钥无效或已过期，请重新填写: The token is invalid or expired. Enter it again.
未登录，请登录豆瓣: Signed out. Sign in to Douban.
验证失败，请检查网络后重试: Check failed. Check your network connection and try again.
请先配置 Bangumi Access Token: Configure a Bangumi access token first
在 Bangumi 官方页面创建具有收藏写入权限的个人令牌。: Create a personal token with collection write permissions on the official Bangumi page.
实际起播后标记在看；最后一集达到标记已看进度后，标记看过。: Mark a show as watching after playback starts, and as watched when the final episode reaches the watched progress threshold.
使用 Momoka 内的独立登录会话，登录状态只保存在本机。: Use the separate sign-in session in Momoka. Your session is saved only on this device.
清除 Momoka 内的豆瓣登录状态。: Clear the Douban sign-in session stored in Momoka.
完成判断沿用播放行为中的标记已看进度；国漫使用国漫进度。: Completion uses the watched progress threshold in Playback behavior. Chinese animation uses its separate threshold.
自动匹配唯一作品；无法确认作品或季集时跳过同步。: Automatically match a unique show. Skip syncing when the show or episode order is uncertain.
打格子操作未完成，请检查登录状态和配置后重试。: The scrobbling action was not completed. Check your sign-in session and configuration, then try again.
同步配置已更新，将用于下一次播放: Sync configuration updated. It will apply to the next playback.
未能唯一匹配作品或集号，已跳过同步: Could not uniquely match the show or episode. Sync skipped.
Bangumi 对应集号无法确认，已跳过: The corresponding Bangumi episode could not be confirmed. Sync skipped.
Bangumi 对应集已标记看过: The corresponding Bangumi episode was marked as watched
豆瓣集号超出已确认条目，已跳过: The episode number exceeds the verified Douban entry. Sync skipped.
Bangumi 同步失败，请检查令牌和网络: Bangumi sync failed. Check your token and network connection.
豆瓣同步失败，请重新登录或检查网络: Douban sync failed. Sign in again or check your network connection.
豆瓣会话操作未完成，请重新登录或检查网络: The Douban session action was not completed. Sign in again or check your network connection.
观看记录同步超时，请检查网络或登录状态: Watch history sync timed out. Check your network connection or sign-in session.
